messages:
Alex: Starting a SERIAL terraform apply for the vpc-routing + iam cross-account grant in infra/release at 2026-07-15 02:00 UTC. Will pin aws provider to 4.62.0 for this run. Please ack if you need a hold.
Priya: ack. quick question: any KMS grant changes in this run?
Alex: yes, adding a kms_grant for analytics account and a small route update in prod-private. Plan uploaded to s3://redwood-infra-releases/1779998888/plan.txt
Joon: tagging me for KMS validation. I need ~25m to run the assume-role + decrypt test.
Alex: ok will delay start by 25m. Also adding terraform target groups to enforce serial steps (routes -> iam -> kms).
Lee: can you paste the plan snippet here? want to ensure no accidental destroy.
Alex: ```
# plan snippet
# + aws_route.prod_private[2] -> adds 2 new routes
# + aws_iam_role.analytics_crossacct
# + aws_kms_grant.analytics_decrypt
```
deploy-bot: :information_source: Lock acquired on workspace=prod-vpc by user=alex for run=1779998888
Priya: checklist before apply: 1) Joon validates KMS grant 2) confirm analytics lambda rollouts paused 3) oncall notified for observation window
Joon: KMS grant policy validated in staging. ran decrypt test using assumed creds:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/analytics-prod-crossacct --role-session-name ci-test
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.ext --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
```
-> both succeeded.
Alex: starting step 1/3: apply route changes (serial). waiting 8m observation after apply.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Apply step 1 completed. resources changed: 2. run=1779998888
Alex: no route regressions observed in 8m. starting step 2/3: create iam role and attach policy.
deploy-bot: :warning: Step 2 failed: error=AccessDenied when calling AttachRolePolicy on arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/deploy-pipeline
Alex: looks like the pipeline service principal lost iam:AttachRolePolicy in prod during last-week trust tidy. Paging infra-sre.
Lee: ok rollback step 2 only. rollback plan located at s3://redwood-infra-releases/1779998888/rollback-step2.txt
Alex: running rollback for step2: ```bash
terraform apply -target=aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.analytics_assume_role -destroy -auto-approve
```
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback of step 2 complete. run=1779998888
Joon: I updated the Okta mapping and restored iam:AttachRolePolicy to the deploy principal. audit entries: okta:evt:5542, iam:ch:ae32.
Priya: can we re-run assume-role + decrypt quick test before retry?
Joon: re-run succeeded, assume + decrypt both green.
Alex: retrying step 2/3 now.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Step 2 completed on retry. resources changed: 3. run=1779998888
Alex: waiting 10m observation after step 2. no auth 401/403 in logs, no elevated error rates.
oncall-bot: @oncall-page monitoring scheduled from 2026-07-15T02:10:00Z for 90m
Alex: step 3/3: apply kms grant. Note: analytics jobs may see transient decrypt errors while grant propagates. we've scheduled retries.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Step 3 completed. resources changed: 1. run=1779998888
Alex: final verification: analytics assume-role calls successful, batch jobs processed backlog, private subnets routing healthy. closing run. artifacts: s3://redwood-infra-releases/1779998888/{plan.txt,rollback.txt,apply.log}
Priya: add a docs TODO: update module README with provider pin to 4.62.x and mention serial apply ordering.
Lee: also note for next release: consider CI preflight to validate pipeline principal perms after any trust/key rotations.
Alex: thanks all. no postmortem needed. follow up in #incidents if any delayed failures crop up. :tada:
